comparability.causal_claim: Topology is controlled observationally; strategy gaps are hypothesis-generating, not causal estimates.

hypotheses.next_test: Publish both local-service and normalized productive KPIs; never compare the two definitions directly.
hypotheses.observation: The local gate excludes PICKUP/DROP/PLACE from productive, while replay productive includes every non-MOVE/non-PASS unit command.

hypotheses.mechanism: A worker without provider work is left idle instead of finishing a compatible local crop task.
hypotheses.next_test: One-cluster local task queue with PASS replacement only; topology, market, worker count and crop calendar frozen.
hypotheses.observation: PASS gap +320.5; crop-service gap -348.6 per episode.

hypotheses.mechanism: The same peak surface is reached, but it is active and serviced for fewer late-game tile-days.
hypotheses.next_test: Age-aware WATER/HARVEST deadlines and no DIG unless a replacement crop is already funded and assignable.
hypotheses.observation: Late crop tile-days -10.7%, late unwatered rate +24.5%, harvest events -31.7%.

hypotheses.mechanism: Preserving 7-7-5 provider routes keeps transfers that the 7-7-0 leader schedule avoids.
hypotheses.next_test: Finish all feasible tasks in the current quadrant before cross-quadrant reassignment; do not alter task priorities.

hypotheses.acceptance: 14 filled pastures, final animals 14, verified losses 0.
hypotheses.next_test: Set the animal resource cap to 14 with zero in-transit surplus.
hypotheses.observation: Codex ends with 15 animal resources for 14 pasture slots and records one verified loss per match; exact leaders end with 14.

hypotheses.next_test: Do not add a worker until priorities 1-4 pass; then run an isolated 12-vs-13 worker ablation.
hypotheses.observation: Exact leaders peak at 13 workers and Codex at 12, but Codex already issues 2.9% more unit commands and many more PASS.

normalization.productive_normalized: all unit commands excluding MOVE and PASS
normalization.reason: Local productive_actions excludes logistics commands, while the replay benchmark includes them.
